title: Court reverses loss of Alabama mother's parental rights for one of two kids
description: A recent ruling by an Alabama appeals court has partially overturned a juvenile court's ruling regarding parental rights. The mother has maintained her rights to her older child but lost her rights to her younger daughter. The court underscored the necessity of evaluating the circumstances of each child individually in such matters. Meanwhile, the father's rights to both children remain revoked due to evidence of substance abuse and inadequate support.

title: Lalit Modi gets British citizenship, extradition prospects take a hit
description: Lalit Modi has announced his acquisition of British citizenship during an event at Oxford Union. While he claims to have faced threats and political persecution, he has refused to return to India. The Enforcement Directorate has ongoing investigations regarding his alleged financial misconduct linked to IPL. Previous requests for his deportation have been denied by the UK government.

title: SF couple's $1.85m Victorian renovation now listed for $5.595m
description: Once a forgotten Victorian gem in Noe Valley, this home was purchased at $1.85 million and thoughtfully revived, blending its charming historic features with modern amenities. Now boasting a listing price of $5.595 million, it offers five spacious bedrooms alongside a private apartment. The extensive restoration preserved its Victorian allure while ensuring necessary structural and aesthetic updates, reflecting the growing trend of revitalizing historic homes in sought-after urban areas.

title: Empty Vande Bharat allowed to run 463km despite 'poor power brake'
description: An empty Vande Bharat train journeyed 463 kilometers from Hatia to Deen Dayal Upadhyaya station despite brake problems. Two loco pilots had reported issues with the power brake before the journey commenced. An investigation revealed that brakes on every coach had been isolated, leading to joint brake failure. The South Eastern Railway's document indicated staff negligence in integrating the braking systems.

Despite the launch of a compensation initiative in February 2022, only a limited number of claims have been successful. Victims often lack awareness of the program due to its complexity.

Hoodbhoy highlighted Salam's significance as a symbol of goodwill between India and Pakistan. He mentioned Salam's lack of recognition in Pakistan due to his Ahmadiyya sect affiliation, affecting youth role models.

description: Kashmiri filmmakers are advocating for a shift towards regional cinema to enhance authentic storytelling and representation. They argue that Bollywood often reinforces stereotypes that misrepresent life in J&K. The current film policy is criticized for not adequately supporting local productions while favoring external filmmakers. Actors and directors are calling for collaboration among regional artists to develop a unique Kashmiri film industry, signaling a significant movement towards self-identity and cultural expression.

Additionally, eleven others sustained injuries; two of them are in critical condition and were transferred to other medical facilities. Quick-thinking locals rushed to help free the trapped individuals before ambulances arrived.

description: Despite facing threats and considerable opposition, Diljit Dosanjh took the stage in Indore to celebrate culture with his loyal fans. His performance included powerful couplets that highlighted resilience and strength, emphasizing that nothing would deter them from their cherished traditions. Although some emails threatened bomb blasts, authorities later confirmed them as hoaxes. Dosanjh's unwavering dedication showcased his commitment to his audience amidst adversity.

title: 'Well-planned conspiracy': BJP refutes reports of 209-candidate list for UP elections
description: The Bharatiya Janata Party's Uttar Pradesh unit has refuted claims regarding a supposed list of 209 candidates. Officials described these reports as false and part of a larger scheme. They cautioned party members against believing in unverified media stories. Additionally, they clarified that the assembly election candidate selection process has yet to commence, highlighting the importance of a methodical and unified approach to such decisions.

title: Prince William, Kate to meet PM Modi in Delhi during three-day India visit
'Divide-and-rule tactics': RSS chief Bhagwat's warning over attempts to split India
description: During a recent event in Jodhpur, RSS leader Mohan Bhagwat spoke fervently about the necessity of national unity. He indicated that smaller identities can lead to societal rifts, reminiscent of colonial tactics. Emphasizing the need for individuals to set aside ego and self-interest, he illustrated his points with lessons from the Mahabharata, stressing that unity is key to overcoming challenges.

title: From Neeraj’s Olympic triumph to her own historic gold! How Gunjan found boxing
description: Gunjan, taking inspiration from Neeraj Chopra, has made history by clinching a gold medal at the Youth Olympic Games. She dominated the women's 48kg category with a decisive 5-0 victory over Algeria's Bouthaina Bensalah. This monumental achievement, alongside L Ambekar Meetei's win, signals India's first double gold in boxing at this event.

title: Trump slams judge’s order blocking Washington golf course renovation
Yash Thakur joins Sachin, Dhoni in unwanted list after ODI debut against NZ
description: Yash Thakur made his ODI debut against New Zealand but was dismissed for a duck on Sunday. He joined the list of 18 Indian players who have scored ducks in their debut matches. While India struggled with bat early on, they managed to secure a 22-run victory in the fifth ODI. The win allowed India to clinch the series 3-1 following New Zealand's consecutive home series victories.

title: Delhi showroom murder: CCTV shows victim's final struggle with 'ex-friend'
description: A CCTV footage captured the final moments of an 18-year-old girl named Shabnam at a clothing showroom. She was allegedly attacked by a 29-year-old man named Suraj, who subsequently dragged her into a trial room. Police discovered Shabnam's body later that evening with injury marks and a knife nearby. Initial investigations suggest a fallout from their prior friendly relationship could be the motive.

title: Nevada rancher's 1,228 acres conserved; grant to treat 350 acres
description: David Park has successfully conserved 1,228 acres of land at Desert Creek Ranch in Nevada. This effort focuses on protecting habitats for the rare Bi-State sage-grouse while allowing continued agricultural activities. A permanent conservation agreement prevents non-agricultural development and preserves the land's ecological value. Additionally, a future grant will facilitate restoration work across 350 acres to control invasive grass and support biodiversity.

title: 'No place for goons': Adhikari's message after Ratan Sheikh encounter
description: In a bold statement, Suvendu Adhikari, the Chief Minister of West Bengal, sent a clear message to those involved in crime after a police encounter resulted in the death of Ratan Sheikh, a prime suspect who reportedly shot at officers during his attempted arrest. Adhikari reaffirmed that criminal activities will not be tolerated in the state. Meanwhile, the police constable injured in the incident remains in stable condition.

title: J&K terror attack: Search operation launched to hunt terrorists who attacked CRPF post
‘He takes pressure off’: Lakshya on Sehwag’s impact in India’s Asia Cup triumph
description: Lakshya Raichandani commended Aaryavir Sehwag for his exceptional play during the Under-19 Asia Cup. Sehwag's impressive scoring led the team to triumph, showcasing a remarkable recovery following a previous defeat to Pakistan. Raichandani emphasised the critical role of a reliable batter in successful run chases, underscoring the team's resilience and the valuable lessons they learned from their earlier misstep.

title: Watch: Forest staff chase lion on motorcycles at Gujarat safari park
description: Three outsourced forest personnel were dismissed after a video showed them chasing a lion on a motorcycle. The incident occurred at Ambardi Safari Park during the Diwali festival holiday period. According to officials, the lion was being directed back to its enclosure when it strayed. An inquiry was launched, but no harassment was confirmed regarding the lion's treatment.

title: Journalist falls off bike taxi, crushed to death by speeding dumper in Bhopal
description: In a tragic incident in Bhopal, 25-year-old journalist Sapna Kumari lost her life after falling from a bike taxi. A motorcycle swerved unexpectedly, causing her to tumble, and a dumper truck following closely ran over her. Both the motorcycle riders and the dumper driver fled the scene promptly. Authorities are now examining CCTV footage to track down those accountable for this heartbreaking accident.

title: Pakistan orders 1 lakh Turkish FPV drones, expands unmanned warfare arsenal
1884 Virginia school for Black children reopens as museum after $6.2m revamp
description: The historic Union Street School in Leesburg, Virginia has reopened as a museum and community centre. After a refurbishment costing around $6.2 million, the building now serves to educate about Black history. Initially established in 1884, it provided education to Black children during segregation until 1958. The new museum aims to preserve memories and share the stories of those associated with the school.

title: Trump blames Biden for aviation chaos, presses Congress for ATC funding
US destroyer returns after 357 days at sea, longest since WWII
description: The USS Spruance has made its way back to Naval Base San Diego after an unprecedented 357-day overseas deployment, the longest for an American destroyer since World War II. Amidst the escalating tensions in the US-Iran conflict, the Navy had to divert two destroyers to the Middle East, further stretching resources. Admiral Daryl Caudle emphasized the ongoing deployment crisis, revealing the strain on maintenance and future operational readiness.

title: 'We did likewise': Mohit Ulva reveals why India celebrated aggressively vs Pakistan
description: Mohit Ulva expressed his thoughts on India's exhilarating win over Pakistan in the Asia Cup final. He noted that the team's celebrations were filled with joy, not aimed at inciting any reactions. Amidst social media backlash, the players concentrated solely on their pursuit, heroically chasing down 338 runs at the last moment. He highlighted the unwavering confidence in the team's spirit, even after facing the loss of eight wickets.

title: From battlefield drones to bigger guns: China upgrades Pakistan-used VT-4 tank

62 endangered San Francisco garter snakes released into wild after zoo care
description: In a remarkable conservation effort, 62 San Francisco garter snakes, previously raised in a zoo, have been successfully released into their natural environment. This project stems from the need to ensure the species’ survival, as they were originally taken from the wild. Alongside this, restoration activities are being implemented to enhance their habitat.

title: 'Brought them in dumper truck': J&K MLA's outburst over handling of slain jawans' bodies
description: BJP MLA Shagun Parihar criticised J&K authorities over the alleged disrespectful handling of two slain Special Police Officers' bodies, claiming they were transported in a dumper truck. She questioned the delay in addressing their families' concerns, saying officials acted only after intervention from the Lieutenant Governor. The bodies of Rashpal Kumar, 45, and Bobby Chand, 57, were recovered from Kishtwar forests on Thursday, with bullet injuries, after they went missing on November 10.

title: 'Preferential trade access already agreed': Piyush Goyal's big update on India-US trade deal
'Didn't seek our views on Jensen Huang': Nvidia research engineer resigns
description: Darrell Dai, a robotics research engineer at Nvidia, has resigned amid communication issues following Jensen Huang's departure. He expressed his admiration for Huang’s vision and the engineering culture he fostered. Dai felt that employees were not heard regarding decisions impacting the company's future direction. His resignation reflects a significant concern over the current leadership and its impact on employee trust.

title: Man finds 1,132 ancient Mexican artefacts in dumpster; students return them
description: During a house clearance in Massachusetts, over 1,100 fascinating pre-Hispanic archaeological items were rescued from a dumpster. Matthew Pioggia, noticing their historical significance, enlisted archaeologist Jeremy Pilver for help. Together with more than 40 high school students, they meticulously documented and cleaned these artifacts over nearly two years, unveiling their southeastern Mexican origins. In August 2026, the collection was respectfully returned to the Mexican Consulate in Boston.

title: Google CEO congratulates SpaceX; says: Still feels like science fiction
description: Sundar Pichai congratulated SpaceX for achieving its first midair catch of a Starship spacecraft after its return. The historic event took place at SpaceX’s Starbase in Texas following the spacecraft's successful re-entry. Starship had completed 14 laps around Earth and deployed advanced Starlink satellites during its flight. Despite the success, a first-stage booster explosion occurred shortly after liftoff during the tests.

title: Watch: Protest outside London Indian restaurant over refusal to serve halal food
Travis Kelce recalls Donna Kelce’s inspiring career journey while raising two sons
description: Travis Kelce recalled watching mom Donna Kelce build her career during childhood visits to her workplace. From office cubicles to a corner office, her determination left a lasting impression and taught him valuable lessons about ambition and hard work.

title: Patrick Mahomes fined $50,000 after Travis Kelce’s touchdown controversy
description: During a tense match against the Buffalo Bills, Patrick Mahomes vented his frustration over a controversial officiating call that negated a crucial touchdown. Ultimately, the Kansas City Chiefs fell short with a 20-17 defeat. Following the game, Mahomes expressed regret for his reaction, receiving a $50,000 fine from the NFL.

title: Breakup revenge: Youth kills ex-partner’s dogs, video-calls her to show ‘proof’
description: Sanjib Bhattacharya reportedly killed both pet dogs belonging to his former partner after their breakup. He allegedly made a video call to show her one dog hanging with a noose. Residents discovered the dogs had been brutally killed, with one beaten with a brick. Animal rights activists and locals protested, leading to Bhattacharya's detention by police. Authorities are now investigating the incident and demanding strict legal action against him.
